amendments.reason: Compile vector interposer only for gather TU; original baseline never uses SendVec, and -Werror rejects its unused static test helper. Production source, headers, single delivery and ordinary tests unchanged.

Fix preexisting timer-exhaustion fixture race: wait OPEN, two native FIFO post turns, then insert both timers on Left worker itself before call. Avoid racing connect-timer cancellation or remote peer quota failure. Production source and headers unchanged. Full focused/root/single validation rerun for stronger fixture.

Matched benchmark now validates complete response bytes for both variants and adds explicit 16KiB multi-chunk cases; production/ordinary tests/headers/delivery unchanged. Preliminary runs remain separate exploratory evidence.

Real native 16-message queued burst disproves unconditional gather packing: 1152 queued bytes retain 16 blocks/8192 capacity. Gather only on empty queue; preserve ordinary tail append when queued. Doubled boundary tests plus real native pool proof; all final functional/delivery/sanitizer/performance evidence rerun for this production change. Prior candidate evidence preserved before-packing-fix.

implementation: Empty native queue: at most two header/body spans in one atomic native copy offer; sole remaining span uses ordinary Send.
Queued bytes: retain ordinary header/body tail append; avoid one temporary native buffer chain per tiny frame.
Same write byte/chunk/turn bounds, Started-before-offer, Sent-after-whole-frame, no offset/credit advance on AGAIN/error.
No new public API/ABI, thread, runtime, adapter heap allocation or contiguous adapter staging copy; native APIs still copy payload.

performance_scope: Matched real native loopback Content-Length TCP; original and gather write implementation, identical dependency objects, headers, compiler options and canonical benchmark with complete echoed-byte validation. One host Engine (2 workers) and shared executor, one connection; closed-loop pipeline1/barrier-window32, 7-byte and 16KiB params. P99 only pipeline1 includes host wait/validation/collection and has coordinated omission. All process threads in CPU, heap runs separate. Unpinned; one warmup/seven rotated samples without noise retries. Not fixed-arrival/remote-network/connection-scale/native Linux/72h or production acceptance.
unresolved_performance: Most final Windows and several WSL metrics are noise-unqualified. Windows window32 CPU medians increased about 5.9% (7B) and 12.8% (16KiB), both unqualified; non-regression is not established for those cases. Keep pinned CPU/connection-scale/fixed-arrival tails/72h release acceptance open.
corrected_and_superseded: Original raw-probe cleanup passed a success status as endpoint Close reason; fixed before final evidence.
Old baseline never calls SendVec: its unused static test interposer was guarded without disabling compiler warnings.

Preexisting timer-quota fixture raced connect timer/remote peer scheduling. It now waits OPEN, performs two owner FIFO post turns, fills only the Left worker quota synchronously, then submits; final root/focused/single/probe suites include this stronger fixture.

Unconditional gather candidate passed protocol tests and showed speedups but failed the real queued-buffer negative control: 1152 bytes retained 16 blocks/8192 payload capacity. Final queue-aware implementation and original both retain 3/1536. Prior candidate reports/inputs/binaries are preserved under before-packing-fix; its medians are not final results.

Early repeated test labels reused executable-copy paths; some superseded exact executable copies were overwritten. Their logs/source hashes remain, but those runs are excluded from final proof. All final acceptance copies use script/log namespaces or immutable content hashes and are verified.
